d:
Uttar pradesh vidhanasbha chunav se pahle samajvadi parti aur kangres ke bich sit bantvare ko lekar khinchtan jari hai. kangres 55 majbut siton ki suchi saunp chuki hai, jabki shuruaati batchit men sapa ki or se 26 siton ka prastav samne aaya hai. donon dalon ke bich siton ki sankhya, majbut siton aur pichhle chunavon ke pradarshan ko lekar matbhed hain. aakhir is gathbandhan men kahan phansa hai siton ka pech? kangres aur sapa ki mangon men kitna antar hai aur bijepi ko chunauti dene ke lie donon dal kis phormule par sahmat ho sakte hain?
Riport: bibisi nyuz hindi
Aavaz: vidit mehra
